subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. 'Ka' borrows one thousand taka from his friend Mr. Tarik. He promised to return back Tarik's money to him within seven days. After seven days Mr. Tarik asked for the money back and Mr. 'Ka' refused to give it. Mr. Sagor, a friend of Mr. 'Ka' is a teacher. He always keeps himself tidy and wear clean dresses. Observing his behaviour his father, Mr. Abdur Rahim said that, "You will receive Allah's mercy as a result of your behaviour".
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is called courtesy?","marks":1,"answer":"Courtesy is being polite, truthful and dignified in speech, behavior and actions."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why is it important to protect Amanat? Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Protecting the Amanat is a sign of faith. A believer cannot betray Amanat under any circumstances. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said, \"He who does not honour trust, does not have Iman.\" Allah does not like the betrayer, indeed leads to poverty. So it is essential for a believer to protect the Amanat."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which virtue of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is absent in the behaviour of Mr. 'Ka'? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Mr. Ka's conduct lacks the quality of keeping promise, one of the virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah. An admirable feature of human life is keeping promises. The word Wada means to promise, to make a commitment to someone, etc. Its need is immense in individual and social life. Its absence is a hindrance to being complete believer. This matter is absent in the behavior of Mr. 'Ka'. Mr. 'Ka' borrows money from his friend for seven days. But he refused to pay after seven days. By doing this he broke his promise. Because making a commitment to someone to do something is called a promise. In Islamic terms, To fulfill a promise or pledge already agreed upon, is called keeping promise. So it can be said that Mr. 'Ka's behavior lacks the quality of keeping promises."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Evaluate the opinion of Mr. Abdur Rahim after identifying that which virtue of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is reflected in the behaviour of Mr. Sagor.","marks":4,"answer":"One of the qualities of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah, cleanliness is observed in Mr. Sagor's behavior. Clean, beautiful and tidy condition is called cleanliness. Keeping the body, mind and other useful things be mindful and pure, free from dirt and unrest is called cleanliness. This quality is noticeable in Mr. Sagor. Mr. Sagor is a teacher according to the stem. He always keeps himself tidy and wears clean clothes. One of the quality of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah which is cleanliness is revealed in his behavior. A clean person receives the special blessing of Allah Ta'ala. Cleanliness is emphasized in Islam. It is not the nature of the believer to be dirty, indecent and smelly. Rather, believers are always clean and pure. The Prophet (SAW) said, \"cleanliness is half of Iman.\" (Muslim) Purity is essential to being true believer. Because no worship is accepted without purity. In order to perform Salat, the body, clothing and place of Salat must be clean and pure. If they are impure, the Salat is not pure. Likewise, recitation of the Qur'an also requires purity. It is also forbidden to touch the Qur'an in an impure state. Allah Ta'ala said, \"And this (Al-Qur'an) none will touch except the pureones.\" (Surah al-Waqiah, verse 79) Clean and neat people are loved by all. Allah Ta'ala also loves them. Allah Ta'ala says, \"Surely Allah loves the repentants and also loves them who stay pure.\"\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Mohsin is a social worker. He arranged food for the hungry people of his locality. He helps those who has lack of cloths by buying Sharees and Lungis. On the other hand, his brother Mr. 'Ka' is a businessman. He mixed the good quality production with the bad qualities in his shop and sell to customers. When the matter came to the attention of the local teacher Mr. Arif, he said that, "Deceiving people is completely forbidden in Islam."
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is called truthfulness?","marks":1,"answer":"Truthfulness is the expression of real and true facts matters."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"Patriotism is the product of faith\" — Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Patriotism is the Product of faith. A true Mumin loves his own country. He works for securing the interest of his country. On the contrary, those who do not love their country are ungrateful. They are guilty of treason and possess bad character. And such person can never be truly pious and Mumin."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which subject of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is reflected by the activities of Mr. Mohsin? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Mr. Mohsin's actions have revealed service to humanity, the merit of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah. Service to humanity refers to serving, looking after, caring, helping people etc. Service to all people irrespective of nation, religion, caste is included in the scope of service to humanity. Almighty Allah shows mercy to those who engage themselves in the service of people. This particular aspect of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is observed in Mr. Mohsin's action. Mru.Mohsin's activities are included in service to humanity. Through his actions, he obeyed the instructions of Allah and Rasul (S). Rasul (SAW) said, \"You help those who are on earth. Then He who is in the heaven will help you.\" (Tumizi) Service to humanity is an indicator of human character. They have a special status in the society. Allah loves them too. So the matter of Hamida's Service to humanity in Akhlaq-i-Hamidah has emerged in the activities of Mr. Mohsin."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Evaluate the opinion of Mr. Arif after identifying the activities of Mr. 'Ka'.","marks":4,"answer":"Mr. Ka's actions are equivalent to fraud, which is totally forbidden in Islam. Fraud is a special form of lying. Cheating someone by keeping the true situation hidden to gain one's own interests is called fraud. Fraud is done by misinforming or betraying others. This feature is also seen in Mr. Ka's action. Mr. Ka is a businessman. He mixes good quality products with low quality products and sells them to customers within its equivalent to fraud. Fraud is absolutely forbidden in Islamic Shari'ah. Fraud is seen in business, trade, transactions, manners and socio-economic fields. This abominable quality creates extreme disharmony in individuals, families, society and the state. So it is an anti-social crime. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said, \"Such a person is an enemy of Allah who sells defective goods without informing the buyer about the defect. The Angels always curse him. (Ibn Majah)\". Finally, it can be said that Mr. Ka's actions have revealed the matter of deception. The result of which is halted in this world and destruction in the hereafter.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: After completion of MA degree two brothers Mr. Kafi and Shafi served in the country's law and order forces. Recently the two of them were given the responsibility of preventing the smuggling of wine in the border area. Kafi believe that loving and serving the country is a form of worship. Mean while, Shafi does not give a proper look in it in exchange for a large amount of money.
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is morality?","marks":1,"answer":"Morality is the combination of honesty, righteousness, good speech and character."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why should the labours be paid their wages before their sweat is dried up? Explain it.","marks":2,"answer":"In the Hadith, the Prophet (PBUH) emphasized on prompt payment of workers' wages. If a laborer is employed in any work, he should be paid his wages as soon as the work is over. Payment should not be unduly delayed. Workers should be treated well. They should be paid their fair wages; Rasul (peace be upon him) emphasized on timely and proper payment of workers in the Hadith."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Explain the work of Mr. Kafi in the light of the text book.","marks":3,"answer":"Kafi's work is an expression of patriotism. atriotism is love, compassion and attraction for one's unrury. Patriotism is a noble human virtue. A true liever loves his country. He works to protect the i. terests and resources of the country. Which is also observed in Kafi's work. According to the stem, Kafi serves in the law enforcement of his country. He is responsible for preventing drug smuggling in border areas. He believes that patriotism and service to the country is an act of worship. Kafi's idea of patriotism is correct. Because patriotism is a great virtue, even as worship. In this regard, the Prophet (PBUH) said, \"To keep awake in the border to protect the homeland in Allah's way is better then all the treasures between the heavens and the earth.\" (Tirmizi) So it can be said that the Kafi's quality of patriotism is a very commendable and noble act."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Identify the action of Shafi and analyze its outcome.","marks":4,"answer":"Shafi's activities showed the issue of taking bribes, the consequences of which are dire both in this world and the Hereafter. Bribery means excessive gain. Acceptance of additional resources or privileges illegally is known as bribery. It is an immoral act and an economic crime. This is revealed in Shafi's work, for which he has to suffer severe consequences. Bribery is a completely Haram and illegal act. Money earned through bribery is completely Haram. And worship is done wearing clothes bought with Haram money, it is not accepted. Nabi Karim (pbuh) said, 'Allah's curse is on both the offerer and the recipient of bribe.' (Bukhari and Muslim) In the hereafter, Hell will be the abode of those who deal with bribes. They will face severe punishment on the Day of Judgment. So, it is proved from the above discussion, Shafi's act is unethical and despicable. In the hereafter there is severe punishment for such actions. So, everyone should refrain from such unethical work, that is, accepting bribes.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Sohel is a teacher. He went abroad for higher training. Despite many opportunities abroad, he returned home and engaged in teaching. On the other hand, his friend. Mr. Rezaul, is an industrialist. He restrains from all evil deeds fearing only Allah the most high and does good deeds. Noticing his activities, Mr. Abdul Hamid said, "The person Islamic scholar who holds this type of character is the most honoured to Allah".
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is self-purification?","marks":1,"answer":"In Islamic terminology, keeping one’s heart free and pure from all kinds of words and actions against Islam is called self-purification."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"Cleanliness is half of Iman.\" — Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"By saying 'Cleanliness is half of Iman', the Prophet (peace be upon him) explained the necessity of being clean to be a true believer. No worship is accepted without purity. In order to perform Salat, the body, clothing and place of Salat must be clean and pure. If they are impure, the salat is not pure. Likewise, reciting or touching the Qur’an in an impure state is forbidden. Allah loves those who stay pure. cleanliness is a mentionable feature of a believer."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is reflected in the character of Mr. Sohel? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Patriotism of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is revealed in Mr. Sohel’s actions. Patriotism is affection and attraction towards one’s country. Patriotism cannot be shown, but this love can be expressed through various actions. Patriotism can be expressed through actions such as protecting the independence of the country, maintaining the country’s resources, making sacrifices for the sake of the country. And this quality has been observed in the activities of Mr. Sohel. In the above stem, Mr. Sohel is a teacher. He went abroad for higher study. Despite many opportunities abroad, he returned to Bangladesh and engaged in teaching. Patriotism is reflected in his work. Because, for the sake of the country, he ignored all the opportunities of foreign countries to return to his country. This is the best example of patriotism. Therefore, it can be said that his sacrifice for the love of his country is very commendable and a shining example of patriotism."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Analyze the statement of Mr. Abdul Hamid in light of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah mentioned in your textbook.","marks":4,"answer":"Mr. Abdul Hamid’s comment regarding the importance of Taqwa as one of the virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamida is correct. Taqwa means to abstain, to live, to fear, to protect oneself. Taqwa is the act of living in accordance with the Qur’an and Sunnah, protecting oneself from all injustices, oppressions and sins out of fear of Allah Almighty. One who adopts taqwa is called Mutuqi. Such characteristics can be observed in Mr. Rezaul from the stem. Taqwa is a great characteristic feature. The importance of Taqwa in human life is immense. Taqwa brings honor, dignity and success in this life and the hereafter. The Mutuqis are the most dignified people in Islamic custom. Allah Ta’ala says, \"To Allah the most honoured among you are those who are men of Taqwa.\" (Surah Al-Huzurat, verse 13). A Mutuqi does not have any obscene and indecent words, actions or thoughts. They always live according to the Qur’an and Sunnah and keep themselves away from wrongdoing out of fear of Allah. Finally, it can be said that the action of Mr. Rezaul has expressed Taqwa. And Abdul Hamid’s comment about the importance of Taqwa is correct. So we should all live our lives with Taqwa.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Arif and Sharif are businessmen. Arif stores commodities for gaining much profit. He creates artificial crisis in market. On the other hand Mr. Sharif maintains the honesty in his speech, activities and behaviors.
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What do you understand by keeping promise?","marks":1,"answer":"Keeping promise means keeping a commitment made to someone."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"A Muslim is a brother of another Muslim.\" — Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"All Muslims are bound by the bond of brotherhood in Islam through the mentioned Hadith. All Muslims are brothers in Islam. Muslims are all brothers irrespective of where they live in the world, whether they are rich or poor. In this regard, Almighty Allah says, \"All Mumins are but brethren to one another.\" (Surah Al-Hujrat, verse 10). It is the teaching of Islam that all the Muslims of the world should treat each other as brothers."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"About what Akhlaq-i-Zaminah is expressed in the character of Arif? Discuss.","marks":3,"answer":"Quality of Akhlaq-i-Zamimah, fraud is revealed in Mr. Arif. Fraud is a special form of lying. Cheating someone by keeping the true situation hidden to gain one’s own interests is called Fraud. Through fraud a person is derived by trickery. This feature is also seen in Arif’s character. Mr. Arif used to create artificial crisis in the market by hoarding goods in the hope of making more profit in his business. Later, by showing the shortage of supply of goods compared to the demand in the market, he made money by deceiving people through increasing the price of goods. Such activities of his constitute cheating. Fraud can occur in many ways, usually seen in financial transactions and business. For example, giving wrong and false information, concealing the defects of goods, selling bad products while showing good ones, selling high-priced goods by mixing it with low-priced goods, running false campaigns on goods, etc. So, businessman Arif’s creation of artificial crisis in the market by hoarding goods in the hope of higher profits indicates deception."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Evaluate the character and activities of Mr. Sharif and what are its positive impacts?","marks":4,"answer":"Through Mr. Sharif’s action, one of the virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah, truthfulness is observed. One of the great virtues of human character is truthfulness. The effort and practice of achieving this quality can bring a person to the best place of dignity and glory. He who can achieve this great quality is known as an ideal person in the society. Mr. Sharif is such an ideal person. Mr. Sharif is always honest in business, speech, actions and manners. We know honesty refers to the quality of being honest. Honesty is manifested in those who try to be honest. Honesty is the main way to make life successful and worthy. The benefits of honesty are found in hundreds of ways. Honest people are naturally virtuous. Everyone in the society loves and trusts him. Honesty empowers people with moral strength. As a result, he never bows down to injustice. An honest person can lead others to the path of truth and beauty in the society. It makes the society happy and prosperous. Almighty Allah says, \"It is that day on which the Truthful shall enjoy the benefits of their truthfulness. For them the award is Jamat.\" (Surah Al-Ma’ida, verse: 119) From the above discussion, it is clear that the action of Mr. Sharif is honesty, which can make people successful in this world and the hereafter.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Suzon, has declared that he will pay the salary of the employees within two days. But he makes delay to pay the salary though the ten days have passed away. A part from this, his wife, his two daughters led their lives with politeness modesty and shyness. As a result peace and discipline prevail in the society.
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Akhlaq?","marks":1,"answer":"People's behavior, thoughts, mentality, actions are collectively called Akhlaq."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"Good character is a reward by itself.\" Explain it.","marks":2,"answer":"The benefits of good character are revealed in the given statement. Good character is a basic human quality and the best asset of life. By this man reaches the highest peak of humanity. For this reason, Allah has made good character or nature a tool for the welfare and liberation of people in the afterlife. In the hereafter in return for said behavior, virtue or reward will be given to people. This is why the Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said, \"Beautiful character is a reward by itself\"."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which lack of the virtue of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is found in by Mr. Suzon's behaviour? Explain it.","marks":3,"answer":"Lack of keeping promise is observed in the behaviour of Suzon. Keeping one commitment to someone is called keeping promise. This is one of the virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah (good character). Allah Talala Himself commanded people to keep their promises and said, \"O you who believe. You keep your promises.\" (Surah Majida, verse-1) But Suzon has breached this promise. According to the stem, Suzon announced that he would pay his employees on the second day of every month. But even after the 10th day of the month, he does not pay the salary. In this work, one of virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah, keeping promise is violated by his action. Keeping promises is one of the characteristics of a believer. The Holy Prophet (SAW) said, \"A person not keeping his promise does not have Deen\" (Musnad-i-Ahmad) Allah Almighty said, \"You keep up your promise. Surely you will be held accountable for your promise\" (Sura: Bani Israil, Ayat: 34) Moreover, not keeping promises is a characteristic of hypocrites, and hypocrites will be in the lowest level of Hell in the hereafter. Allah Almighty has ordered the believers not to break their promises. He said, \"O you who believe! why do you say what you do not yourselves do\" (Sura Ash Safr, verse 13) So it can be said that keeping promises is one of the qualities of human character. This character was violated in the behaviour of Suzon."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Analyze the importance of the virtue of Mr. Suzon's wife and daughters according to Al-Quran and Hadith.","marks":4,"answer":"Courtesy is observed in the behavior of Suzon's wives and daughters, which is of immense importance in the light of the Qur'an and Hadith. To be gentle, civilized and polished in words, conduct and movement is called courtesy. The scope of modesty is very wide. It is the aggregate of moral qualities. Modesty is expressed through the combination of qualities such as politeness, humbleness, beauty, good taste, humility etc. In the behavior of Suzon's wife and daughters that is revealed. According to the stem, Suzon's wife and two daughters lead a life of politeness, humbleness, beauty, good taste and humility. Which is the feature of courtesy. And the importance of courtesy in Islam is immense. In many places in the Qur'an and Hadith Allah has instructed people to lead a modest life, saying, \"And you (women) Shall stay indoors and shall not make a show of the age of ignorance (Jahiliyyah days).\" (Surat al-Ahzab, verse 33) Elsewhere the Prophet (peace be upon him) said, \"Obscenity turns anything bad and modesty (shyness) adorns everything\" (Tirmizi). Finally, it can be said that courtesy is one of the virtues of human life, so everyone should be accustomed to living modesty.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Riya borrowed the English Text book of his friend Hanif yesterday for not finding his own book, and returned it just after coming to school as he promised. When he went to pay the rickshaw fare, he found that he had no money in his pocket. Being desperate, he asked another friend, Arif to borrow 100 taka. Arif replied that he had no money. Arif’s father who was standing nearby, heard this and called him and said, "You have money with you, it is wrong to deny it instead."
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Akhlaq-i-Hamidah?","marks":1,"answer":"The nature or character that is praised by the society and liked and appreciated by Allah Ta’ala and Rasulullah (SAW) is called Akhlaq-i-Hamidah."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"Fitna-fasad is worse than murder\"—Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Fitna is more heinous than murder because it creates opportunities for all kinds of crimes and misdeeds. The unrest situation that is created in the society through fear, torture, robbery, disappearance, murder, kidnapping, etc. is fitna-fasad. Fitna-fasad is a very serious crime. By this, all injustice and oppression starts in the society. In unrest condition, dishonest people have the opportunity to commit all kinds of sins. That is why Allah Ta’ala says, ‘Fitna is worse than murder.’ (Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 191)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which quality is expressed in Riyad? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"One of virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah which is keeping promises is expressed in Riyad. Wada is called Al-Ahdu in Arabic. It means to promise, contract, promise something or commit to do something etc. In the Islamic terminology, Wada means to fulfil properly a promise or pledge already agreed upon. Which is observed in Riyad’s activities. According to the stem, Riyad couldn’t find his English book one day, so he borrowed it from his friend Hanif and, as promised, went to school the next day and returned the book. Through his work the promise has been fulfilled. Because, he kept his promise to his friend. Indeed its importance and necessity is immense. Keeping promise establishes peace and order in society. Everyone loves a person who keeps his promises. Therefore, it can be said that one of virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah which is keeping promises is observed in Riyad."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Identify the quality which is absent in Arif’s character and justify the statement of his father.","marks":4,"answer":"Arif’s behavior lacks the quality of truthfulness. His father’s comment about this is correct. As-sidg is the Arabic word for truthfulness. The practice of telling the truth in general is called truthfulness. In other words, Sidg is the complete or precise description of an event or subject without any change, amplification or distortion. Which is missing in Arif’s behavior. According to the stem, as Riyad doesn’t have money for rickshaw, he asks his friend Arif to borrow him one hundred taka. Arif replied that he had no money. Arif’s father was standing nearby and heard this. Then he called Arif and said, it is wrong to deny even though you have money. That is, it is understood that Arif is lying. And his father made the right comment about this. Because the opposite of truthfulness is lying which is done by Arif. And lying is a great sin. It is the root of all sins. Allah is very displeased with liars. No one loves or respects a person who tells lies. Rather, everyone hates him. So it can be said that his father’s comment is correct because Arif’s behavior shows lying. So we should always stay away from lies and always speak the truth.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Dr. Miftah examines more than one hundred patients daily free of charge in his chamber. He gives medicine free for those who can not afford to buy. He even distributes winter clothes to the needy in winter. On the other hand, Mr. Raju is a small businessman. He spends for the family according to its needs. He does not like to waste. Again, he hates austerity.
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Taqwa?","marks":1,"answer":"Taqwa is to refrain from all wrongdoing, oppression and sinful acts out of fear of Allah Ta’ala."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why are lewd and lascivious acts prohibited? Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Obscenity being one of the aspects of Akhlaq-i-Zamimah, so it is forbidden to do any obscene work. courtesy is to be elegant, beautiful and graceful. Obscenity is the opposite of courtesy. Obscene and indecent acts destroy humanity and moral values of people. People lose their humanity and adopt animal behaviour. As a result lawlessness, adultery, obscenity spread in the society. Islam commands all people to be modest. Islam forbids those acts which are against courtesy. Therefore obscene and indecent acts are prohibited."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"What is revealed in Dr. Miftah's activities? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Service of humanity is expressed through Miftah’s action. Service to humanity refers to serving, looking after, caring, helping people etc. People are Ashraful Makhlugat. As such, showing sympathy and helping others is Service to humanity. This is revealed in Dr. Miftah’s work. Dr. Miftah sees more than 100 patients in his chamber free of charge every day. He provides free medicine to those who cannot afford it. Even in winter, he distributes warm clothes to the needy. Such work of him is included in Service to humanity. The Prophet (peace be upon him) commanded, feed the hungry, serve the sick, set the prisoner free, free the debtor from debt. (Bukhari), He also said, \"You help those who are on earth. Then He who is in the heaven will help you.\" (Tirmizi) Service to humanity is indicative of the good character of man. So it can be said, Dr. Miftah’s action reveals the service to humanity which is one of the virtues of a believer."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Which aspect of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is a revealed in the activities of Raju? Analyze.","marks":4,"answer":"Akhlaq-i-Hamidah's frugality is revealed in Mr. Raju's action. Frugality is spending according to need, sense of proportion, accuracy in speech and actions, fair use of wealth etc. Appropriate and proportionate use of wealth is frugality. That is, spending as much as is necessary, not less or more is frugality. Which can be seen in the action of Mr. Raju. According to the stem, Mr. Raju is a small businessman. He spends in the family as needed. He does not like to waste. Again he hates to resort to miserliness. In other words, the characteristic of frugality can be seen in him. Because frugality is about spending as much as you need without overspending. Through this, fair use of resources is ensured. In this case overspending, wasting or miserliness cannot be done. Rather spend as and when required. Allah Ta’ala says in Al-Qur’an, ‘And when they spend, they do not waste and not show miserliness either. Rather they adopt the middle course in between.’ (Surat al-Furqan, verse 67). Frugality endows people with many virtues. It is pleasing to Allah. From the above discussion, the frugality of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is revealed in the actions of Mr. Raju. So we should not waste and spend as needed.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Recently, a report on making fake medicine went viral in social media. Seeing this, a man said, "No man could do such a heinous act, if he would think of standing before Allah." Being agreed to the opinion of man. Mr. Jashim said, "like this, many heinous activities are in practice in our society. Such as, making fake currency, giving less in weight and spreading rumour. These people involved in such activities will never be treated as the follower of our great Prophet (Sm.)."
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Akhlaq-i-Hamidah?","marks":1,"answer":"The nature or character that is favourite to Allah Talaia and Rasulullah (SAW) and admirable and lovable in the society is called Akhlaq-i-Hamidah."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"Modesty is a distinct portion of Iman\" - Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"The Prophet (SAW) said the mentioned Hadith to explain the importance of courtesy. Islam is a religion of beauty. It encourages beautiful, fair and orderly living. So in Islam, people are instructed to be humble, gentle and decent. Acts which are against courtesy are forbidden in Islam. And one of the aspects of purity and courtesy is modesty. Because humility helps people to be modest. This is why the Prophet (SAW) said, \"Modesty is a distinct portion of Iman\" (Abu Daud)."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which side of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah has been reflected in the opinion of mentioned man? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Taqwa, one of the virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah, has been reflected in the opinion of mentioned man. The word Taquva means fear of Allah and self-purification. It is the fear of Allah and refraining from all injustice, oppression and sin. Allah sees and knows everything about people and everyone is accountable to Him. In the Hereafter, people will have to answer for every act of the world. Good deeds will be rewarded with Paradise and bad deeds will be punished in Hell. And refraining from all kinds of injustice, torture, obscene actions and thoughts for fear of being held accountable before Allah the Most High is called Taquva. About this, Almighty Allah says, \"That person will enter Jamat who cherishes the fear of standing before Allah and saves himself from evil inclinations.\" (Sura: Naziat, Ayat: 40-41)"},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Do you think the opinion of Mr. Jashim is appropriate? Opine in the light of the relevant topic of Akhlaq-i-Zamimah.","marks":4,"answer":"Yes, I think Mr. Jashim's comment is correct as the fraud issue has come to light in the stem. Fraud means cheating, betraying, defrauding, breach of trust. This is a special form of lying. Fraud can take many forms. Usually instances of Fraud are observed in financial transactions and business. In the stem Mr. Jashim said that many more such things are happening in our society while aggregating with a person about fake medicine. Like someone is counterfeiting currency. Someone is providing less in weight. Others are spreading false rumours. Those who do this will never be considered as the Ummah of our Prophet. His statement indicates fraud. And his statement regarding its bad effects is also correct. Because, fraud is very disgusting and hateful act. It is equivalent to lying. Even in many cases fraud is worse than lying. Because fraud involves two sins. One is lying and the other is breach of trust. Therefore deception must be avoided at all times. A person who deceives is not a true believer.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Jahir was working in a company. After some days, he did not like the job and left it. Now he spends time wandering here and there with laziness. On the other hand, his friend Abdur Rahim, gets hurt when he sees something good in anyone. He always expects harm of others. In perspective of this character, his wife Samia said, "The sins of a person who cherishes malice to other are not forgiven."
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is frugality?","marks":1,"answer":"Generally use of wealth appropriately and according to necessity is called frugality."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"The traitor is not Mumin.\" — Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"The saying 'A traitor is not a Mumin' indicates the immense importance of protecting the Amanat. Safeguarding Amanat is part of Iman. Betraying Amanat is not the characteristic of a believer; rather, it is a sign of a hypocrite. Safeguarding Amanat is a must for the believer. A true believer never betrays Amanat. The Prophet (pbuh) said, \"He who does not honour trust, does not have Iman\" (Musnad-i-Ahmand) Therefore, to be a believer, Amanat cannot be betrayed in any way."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which Akhlaq-i-Zamimah is exposed in Mr. Jahir? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"In Mr. Jahir's act, Akhlaq-i-Zamimah's indolence is revealed, which is highly reprehensible behavior. Indolence refers to the desire not to work. It belongs to Akhlaq-i-Jamimah. Islam does not support this which is observed in Mr. Jahir's behaviour. In the stem, Mr. Jahir worked in an organization. After some time he did not like it and left it. Now he wanders here and there and spends idle time. Such actions on his part indicates indolence. Because, sitting idle or unemployed without doing any work despite having the ability is due to indolence. It causes laziness in people. A lazy person is involved in various dishonest and immoral activities. As a result, social degradation occurs. Indolence leads to waste of human talent, energy and time. Almighty Allah says, \"However, as soon as prayer is over, you spread up on earth and seek Allah's favours\" (Sura: Al-Jumua, verse 10) The Holy Prophet (PBUH) said, \"Seeking sustenance in a legitimate way is an additional Farz work after the other Farz.\" (Baihaqi) There is no scope for indolence in Islam. So, it can be said that Mr. Jahir's Indolence has been revealed here."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Is the statement of Samia correct? Analyze in light of Islam.","marks":4,"answer":"Samia's statement about the consequences of jealousy is correct. Jealousy is one of the worst aspects of Akhlaq-i-Jamimah. Jealousy is having a negative attitude towards others, feeling superior, hating others, wishing others harm due to enmity, not being able to tolerate others' prosperity or happiness, etc. Jealousy is a very reprehensible trait of human character. And in the character of Abdur Rahim of the stem also reflects this reprehensible trait. Samia's statement about jealousy is correct. Because not being able to tolerate others progress, trying to harm others is included in jealousy. Jealousy is completely prohibited in Islamic Shariah. It destroys the human character. A jealous person can never be virtuous. The jealous person consider himself superior and his main concern is his own interest. He hates others and wishes destruction to others. As a result, unity and solidarity in the human society perish and peace and order are destroyed. In addition, Jealousy and envy also harms the person in the hereafter. Jealousy destroys all the good deeds of people. A jealous person's sins are not forgiven. The Prophet (PRUH) said: \"The sins of three persons are not forgiven; One of these is he who cherishes malice to others.\" (Adabul Mufrad). From the above discussion, it can be said that jealousy destroys the good deeds and good characters of people. As a result, the jealous person faces great danger in both the life here and the hereafter.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: The government of Bangladesh sent food, doctors and medicines to help the people of non-Muslim country Nepal affected by the severe earthquake. Bangladesh helps Rohingya Muslims suffering from Myanmar's persecution by providing food, security and shelter.
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Taqwa?","marks":1,"answer":"Taqwa is refraining from all wrongdoings and sinful act for the fear of Allah."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Explain the importance of Shyness in Islam.","marks":2,"answer":"Shyness is very important in Islam because people can lead a beautiful, fair and elegant life due to this. Shyness is one of the characteristics of courtesy. It helps people become modest. It is not at all possible to maintain Imam without shyness. The Prophet (PBUH) said, \"Modesty is a distinct portion of Imam.\" (Sunane Abu Daud) Shyness makes people beautiful. The modest person has been given good news of welfare in this life and the hereafter."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which aspect of Islam has been reflected in the helping of the people of Nepal by Bangladesh Government? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Communal harmony has been reflected due to support provided to the people of Nepal by the Government of Bangladesh. Communal harmony is the harmony and love between people of different communities. People of many religions, castes and nationalities live in our society. Each of them is a community. Communal harmony is the culture of mutual unity and cooperation among these communities living in the society. This aspect has reflected in the activities of Bangladesh government. It can be seen in the stem that Bangladesh government provided food, doctors and medicine to help the affected non-Muslims in Nepal. Communal harmony can be found in this work of Bangladesh government. As a result of communal harmony, people learn to respect each other. Moreover, helping others by maintaining communal harmony is equivalent to helping the creations of Allah. Therefore, the work of the Bangladesh government i.e. maintaining communal harmony is beneficial for both the life here and hereafter."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Explain the behaviour of Bangladesh Government with the Rohingya Muslim in the light of your text book.","marks":4,"answer":"The treatment of the Rohingya Muslims by the Bangladesh government indicates a sense of brotherhood. Brotherhood is the expression of brotherly feelings. All Muslims in the world are brothers. So they will behave brotherly towards each other. And this develops the qualities of cooperation, sympathy etc. Which is noticeable in the behavior of the Bangladesh government. In the stem, it can be seen that the Bangladeshi government has helped the Rohingya Muslims of Myanmar by providing food, security and shelter when they were persecuted and took refuge in Bangladesh. And this act of Bangladesh government shows the sense of brotherhood. Islam is a religion of welfare. All its teachings and ideals are benevolent for mankind. Islam has also given guidance on brotherhood. Allah Tâala says, All Mumins are but brethren to one another. (Surah Al-Hujarat, verse 10) Also, the Prophet (PBUH) called this brotherhood of Muslims like a body. If any part of the body pains, it affects the entire body, just like if a Muslim in any part of the world is persecuted, it affects the entire Muslim nation. Finally, it can be said that Islam has given great importance over maintaining the brotherhood. As it is reflected in the work of the Bangladesh government, I think it has been a very commendable and virtuous work.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Jahangir and Naim work in the same company. After the office work, Mr. Jahangir brought some mangoes, oranges and grapes from the neighbouring shop. But while paying the money, he found that some money was short. So he borrowed 1,000 taka from his colleague Naim on the condition that he would pay it tomorrow and paid it back the next day as promised. Their children 'A' and 'B' study in the same school. They properly use and protect school's desks, benches, chairs, tables, chalks and dusters.
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is meant by 'Ideals' of life?","marks":1,"answer":"Activities of great man which are followed to make life perfect and successful are called 'Ideals' of life."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why is Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.) called 'The Savior of Islam'—Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Hazrat Abu Bakr (Ra) is called the savior of Islam for his outstanding contribution to the service of Islam. After the death of the Prophet (peace be upon him), Hazrat Abu Bakr (Ra) very efficiently suppressed the apostates and Zakat deniers. Moreover, when there was a threat of the destruction of the Holy Quran due to the martyrdom of many Haffiz of Quran in the Battle of Yamama, he arranged for the Holy Quran to be recorded in a book form. He is called the savior of Islam due to the implementation of these revolutionary measures."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"What is found expression in the activities of Mr. Jahangir? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"One of virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah which is keeping promises is expressed in Mr. Jahangir's actions. A promise is an commitment, vow, agreement, condition, pledging to do something for someone. To fulfill a promise or pledge already agreed upon, is called keeping promise. And this is the quality present in Mr. Jahangir. According to the stem, Mr. Jahangir buys some mangoes, oranges etc. from the shop near the office. But while paying the money, he saw that some money was missing. So he borrowed 1000 taka from colleague Mr. Naeem on the condition of paying tomorrow. The next day he paid it as promised. By doing so, he has fulfilled his promise. The importance of keeping promises in human life is immense. It establishes peace and order in the society. Everyone loves a person who keeps his promises. Everyone trusts and believes in him. He gets respect and dignity in the society. Promises must be kept according to Islam. So it can be said that Mr. Jahangir kept his promise."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Which quality of 'Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is revealed in the works of 'A' and \"B\"? Analyze the importance of acquiring such qualities in students' life.","marks":4,"answer":"In A and B's work one of the virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah, protecting Amanat is revealed. The importance of acquiring such qualities in students' lives is immense. Usually keeping any money, resources or secrets with someone is called Amanat. However, in a broad sense, entrusting not only wealth but anything is called Amanat. One's life, property, honor, promise, all the furniture of the school to the students are Amanat which has been revealed in A and B's work. According to the stem, A and B study in the same school. They properly use and protect all school materials including desks, benches, chairs, dusters. By doing this they protected the Amanat. Safeguarding Amanat is particularly important in the Islamic philosophy of life. Protecting Amanat is especially prevalent in person with good character. Protection of Amanat is the command of Allah Ta'ala, Allah says, 'You return the Amanats to their owners' (Surah Nisa, verse 58). Protecting the Amanat is a must for the believer. A true believer never betrays Amanat. Protecting Amanat is a sign of faith. The Prophet (peace be upon him) was the epitome of trustworthiness. Even his worst enemies knew him as a trustee. They called him Al Amin or the Trustee. From the above discussion, it is understood that the virtue of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah, protecting Amanat is revealed in the work of A and B. So we will always try to protect the Amanat by fulfilling the responsibilities and duties.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question:
---
Amina and Lamia are two friends. One day Amina kept a gold chain with Lamia as a deposit. After some days, Amina wanted her chain and Lamia returned it. On the other hands, one day Sahana paid the bus fare of an old and poor woman. After it, she also bought the woman a new dress. Being happy, the woman said, "Allah will surely reward you for your good deeds."
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is courtesy?","marks":1,"answer":"Being polite, civilized and elegant in speech, conduct and action is called courtesy."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"Akhlaq-i-Zamimah brings unhappy in personal life.\"—Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Akhlaq-i-Zamimah i.e. condemnable nature makes a person lower than an animal. No shred of scruples, morality and human values are found in him. He sacrifices human ideals to protect his own interests. As a result, his life becomes full of various kinds of wickedness. Due to this there is no peace in his life. He has to live with fear, hatred, mistrust and humiliation."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is exposed in the character of Lamia? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":""},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Analyze the accuracy of the woman's statement in light of the Akhlaq-i-Hamidah mentioned in your textbook.","marks":4,"answer":"One of the qualities of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah, service to humanity is revealed in the activities of the teacher Sahana. And this statement is correct. Service to humanity is an indicator of great human character. A person who serves people is noble. He has a special status in the society. Almighty Allah loves such a person. He who serves and helps people, Allah Ta'ala also helps him and has mercy on him. Which is similar to the comments made by the elderly woman. In the stem, Service to humanity is manifested through Sahana's work. Because Service to humanity means serving people, looking after, taking care, helping people etc. Serving all people regardless of their nation, religion and caste is included in the scope of human service. It is the important duty of man to be kind to all creations of Almighty Allah, to treat them properly, to help the helpless people. Fulfilling this duty is Service to humanity. Allah and the Prophet (SAW) ordered people to serve humanity. The Prophet (SAW) said, \"You help those who are on earth. Then He who is in heaven will help you\" (Tirmizi). Finally, it can be said that the teacher Sahana's work shows the service to humanity so the old woman's comment is correct. And it is essential for us to serve people in all situations.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Salma and Zakia makes sweet in their house and they supply to different shops. One day Salma proposes to Zakia for mixing powder of pulses and wheat instead of flour to reduce the cost of sweet. But, Zakia refuses this proposal and she propagates it to her other friends in absence of Salma.
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is the 'Ghibat'?","marks":1,"answer":"Ghibat is such foul talk about another person in his absence which if he hears, would take it to heart."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"What do you understand by the self purification?","marks":2,"answer":"Self-purification refers to keeping oneself free from sin in the fear of Allah Ta’ala. Self-purification means to rectify oneself, to refine oneself, to purify oneself, etc. To keep one's mind free and clean from all kinds of bad talk and deeds is called self-purification. In order to purify oneself, the heart must be purified from everything other than the remembrance, obedience and worship of Allah Ta’ala."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Identify the proposal of Salma and explain it according to your textbook.","marks":3,"answer":"One of Akhlaq-i-Zamimah’s characteristic features, fraud is observed in Salma’s character. Fraud is a special form of lying. Seeking self-interest by means of concealing the real phenomenon through deceit or disguise is termed as fraud. Through fraud a person is deceived by trickery. This feature can be seen in Salma’s character as well. Salma, hoping to make more profit in her business, asked Zakia to make sweets at a lower cost by using cheaper flour and powder of pulses instead of flour. So that in business, there is more profit in exchange/instead of less cost. Such activities of her are included in fraud. Fraud may occur in various ways, Generally, instances of this are more common in financial transactions and business. For example, providing wrong and false information, concealing product defects, selling bad products by showing good ones, mixing high-priced products with low-priced products, false advertising of products etc. So it can be said that Salma and Zakia’s sweet business by mixing low-cost flour and powder of pulses to make sweets at low cost is deceiving which is a heinous crime."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Assess the nature of Zakia that is expressed in the last part of the stem. Then write down its consequences.","marks":4,"answer":"Zakia’s activity mentioned in the stem is ghibat. The consequences of ghibat backbiting are dire. In the stem, Zakia reveals Salma’s fault to another friend in absence of Salma. This is ghibat. Because the Prophet (PBUH) said about this, \"Ghibat is - you criticize your brother in such a way which if he comes to know/hear, he will suffer pains.\" (Muslim). Ghibat or slander is illegal in Islamic Shari’ah. Allah said, \"You shall not backbite one another. Do you love eating the flesh of your dead brother? In fact, you do dislike that.\" (Surah Al-Huzurat, Ayat: 12) Ghibat is compared in the Quran to eating the flesh of one's dead brother. So Ghibat is a very disliked act. No conscious man can like such work. Allah does not like Ghibat. The Holy Prophet (PBUH) has warned us about the consequences of Ghibat in the Hadith. Rasulullah (Sm.) said, \"Ghibat is more serious than rape.\" Sahabis asked, \"O Rasulullah (Sm.)! How can Ghibat be a more deadly crime than rape? Rasul (Sm.) said, 'If someone repents after rape, Allah the Most High may forgive him. But a back-biter will not be forgiven by Allah until the victim of his offence forgives him.\" (Baihaqi) From the above discussion, it is clear that Zakia’s act is Ghibat and it has dire consequences for people.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Numan is a van driver. He leads his private life following the rules and regulations of Islam. If anybody falls ill, he takes the sick person to the hospital by his Van. On the other hand, an honourable Imam was a passenger of a CNG, suddenly he found a bag full of money left on the CNG. The Imam took it and handed over to its real owner finding him after a great search.
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Ihram?","marks":1,"answer":"Ihram refers to the formal intention of Haji."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"How should be the employer-employee relationship? Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"The employee-employer relationship should be responsible and forgiving. Both employer and employee are dependent on each other. So the relationship between them will be very close. Just as the employer will not overwork the employee and will pay the salary on time, the employee will also perform the duties assigned by the employer smoothly. Again, if the employee does anything wrong, the employer will look at it with a forgiving eye. In the Hadith, there is a provision of forgiving the employee up to seventy times a day."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"What is expressed in the deed of Mr. Numan, the Van driver? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"One of the virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah which is service to humanity is observed in the work of van driver Mr. Numan. Service to humanity means serving, caring, looking after, helping people etc. Service all people irrespective of nation, religion, caste is included in the scope of service to humanity. Service to humanity can be done in many ways. For example, giving food to the hungry, giving clothes to the naked, serving the sick, giving financial help to the helpless and needy people, etc. which is observed in Mr. Numan's actions. According to the stem, Mr. Numan took the sick person to the hospital in a van. This act of him refers to service to humanity. Serving humanity is one of the virtues of a believer. A believer is always engaged in the service of other people. The Holy Prophet (peace be upon him) said in this regard, \"You give food to the hungry, nurse the sick, free the captives and redeem the debtor\" (Bukhari) So it can be said, Mr. Numan has done commendable and virtuous work by serving humanity."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Identify the deed of the honourable Imam and analyze it.","marks":4,"answer":"Honesty is observed in the action of Mr. Imam. Honesty is an important aspect of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah. This moral quality derived from Taqwa or fear of Allah prevents people from all kinds of wrongdoing and sin. If a person is honest, he is capable of leading a good moral life. If an individual adopts honesty in his life, everyone in the society loves and trusts him. This quality is expressed in Mr. Imam. According to the stem, Mr. Imam found a passenger’s bag of money left in the CNG. He inquired and returned the money to the passenger. His work shows honesty. And the importance of honesty in human life is immense. A fair, beautiful and peaceful society will be developed if all the people living in the society adopt honesty in every field. Trust in each other will inspire everyone to work unitedly. As a result, the society will progress. And if the responsible people in the state are honest, they will work to protect the interests of the people without considering their own interests. They will consider the state resources as Amanat and will put them to good use. As a result, the development of the state will be accelerated. Our beloved Prophet was the epitome of honesty and faithfulness. This honesty enabled him to build an ideal state. And Mr. Imam possesses this quality of honesty."}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Tuhin is a social worker. He is quite aware about the young of the society. If any of the younger do good deeds, he rewards them for giving inspiration. And if someone does wrong deeds, by any way he stops it and advises to do good deeds. Mr. Tuhin's younger brother Mr. Ka's friend Talib got admission in Dhaka University this year. Mr. 'Ka' becomes upset for his admission and could not accept the matter easily. So, he tries to avoid Talib. Understanding the behaviour of Mr. 'Ka', his father Mr. Abdus Salam told, "This type of behaviour destroys the good deeds of people."
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is called self-purification?","marks":1,"answer":"Keeping one's heart free and pure from all kinds of words and actions against Islam is called self-purification."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"\"It is a mark of wisdom on the part of a person to follow the middle course in respect of expenditure\" — Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"Frugality protects people from the evils of waste and miserliness. So frugality or middle course should be adopted in spending. A frugal person makes proper use of Allah's blessings. As a result he brings peace and prosperity to the society. On the other hand, miserliness and wastage create various disturbances in the society. An extra-vagant's wealth quickly runs out. As a result, he lives in poverty and suffering. On the other hand, miserliness gives rise to bad blood and enmity among people. So it is reasonable to adopt a middle course in terms of expenditure."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which virtue of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah is reflected in the behaviour of Mr. Tuhin? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Mr. Tuhin's behavior reveals the aspect of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah's commanding deeds and forbidding wrong deeds. ‘Amr bil Marul’ refers to commanding someone for justice and good deeds. And ‘Nahi Anil Munkar’ means to prevent someone from all evil, bad and obscene activity. There should always be a certain number of people in society to enjoy good deeds and forbid bad deeds. This aspect is revealed in the behavior of Mr. Tuhin. Mr. Tuhin is a social worker. If any of the youths do good work, he encourages them. If someone does wrong, he gives the right advice. It refers to the commanding good deeds and forbidding wrong deeds. Because in today's society various injustices and inconsistencies have increased, which is causing social disaster. In this situation, it has become necessary to bring people back to the right path. The command of righteous deeds promotes righteous and just deeds in the society. And forbidding wrong deeds eradicates injustice, instability and oppression from society. People learns to understand justice-injustice, good and bad, gradually follows the path of truth and justice. Thus the aspect of commanding good deeds and forbidding evil deeds is revealed in the behavior of Mr. Tuhin."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Analyze the comment of Mr. Abdus Salam after identifying the behaviour of Mr. 'Ka'.","marks":4,"answer":"In 'Ka's behaviour, Akhlaq-i-Zamimah's jealousy is revealed. Such practices destroy human character. Jealousy is one of the worst aspects of Akhlaq-i-Jamimah. Jealousy is having a negative attitude towards others, feeling superior, hating others, seeking others' harm through enmity, not being able to tolerate others' happiness, etc. Jealousy can also be seen in the behavior of 'Ka'. Ka' was upset and simply could not accept the fact that 'Ka's friend Talib got admission in Dhaka University which indicates jealousy. Such practices destroy human character. Social peace requires equality, friendship, love, brotherhood, mutual cooperation and sympathy. Jealousy destroys these virtues. A jealous person thinks of himself as superior and sees his own interests as the greatest. He hates others. He develops enmity towards others, desires others' downfall. It destroys unity, solidarity in human society and there is no peace and order. A jealous person's character gradually becomes filled with various dishonest traits, which affect his overall character. Finally, it can be said that jealousy destroys the good deeds and virtues of people. So for personal success and national development, everyone should give up enmity and hatred. ---\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Nayon is a high level government officer. No files of his office run without extra money. He perform Salat and Sawm in his personal life besides, he gives charity. His son, Sujon Sarker, after completion of higher degree from foreign university, leads a jobless life. When he was told about work, he said, "My father does have huge amount of wealth and property, no need to do work".
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is cheating?","marks":1,"answer":"Seeking self-interest by means of concealing the real phenomenon through deceit or disguise is called cheating."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"What are bad effects of Ghibat?","marks":2,"answer":"The bad effects of Ghibat in this life and hereafter are very terrible. Nobody likes a slanderer. Everyone shuns and hates him. If one's mistake is revealed to others, it leads to quarrels and even fights. As a result, the society is filled with chaos. Allah will not forgive the sins of the backbiter until the person he slandered forgives him. The Prophet (PBUH) called ghibat more serious than rape. So we should all keep ourselves away from ghibat."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Identify the act of Mr. Nayon and explain it in light of your text book.","marks":3,"answer":"In the behaviour of Mr. Nayon, bribery, an Akhaq-i-Zamimali, is reflected. Bribery is a condemnable habit of human life. It means excess gain. Unlawful demand in cash or kind, taking or demanding money, wealth, benefit or advantage in excess of what is due or normal claim is called bribe. It is a heinous financial crime. It generates problems like economic disparity and class distinction in society. In Mr. Nayon's behaviour, this heinous crime is evident. Mr. Nayon is a high level government officer. No files of his office run without extra money. This is indeed bribery. We know that the officers and employees of an institution receive a certain amount of payment or salary in return for their work. But if they illegally take or claim anything extra in addition to their payment for this work, that excess gain is a bribe. Hence, bribery is exposed in Mr. Nayon."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Analyze the result of the activity of Sujon Sarker in light of Islam.","marks":4,"answer":"Indolence to work is seen in Sujon Sarker. Sitting idle without doing any work despite having the ability is called indolence. If a disabled person such as blind, handicapped etc. cannot work then it is not indolence. Instead, sitting idle without doing any work voluntarily despite having the ability is indolence. Which also seen in Sujon Sarker. In the stem, Sujon Sarker leads an unemployed life despite being highly educated with the excuse of his father's wealth. And this attitude is indolence. There is no scope for indolence in Islam. Allah Tabla says, \"However, as soon as prayer is over, you spread up on earth and seek Allah's favours.\" (Sum: Al-Jumua, Ayat: 10) Emphasizing on the importance of work, the holy prophet (Sm.) said—\"Seeking sustenance in a legitimate way is an additional Farz work after the other Farz.\" (Baihaqi) So if one refrains from work despite being able to, then he disobeys the orders of Allah and the Prophet (PBUH). Due to which he will have to suffer severe consequences in the Hereafter. Finally, it can be said that Indolence can never improve any people or nation. So everyone should engage himself herself in any kind of work, big or small, according to his/her ability. Actually unemployment cannot solve anything in life.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: The Headmaster of the secondary school of the city built a large child care center in his house with wealth from his father and money from his own job. Hundreds of orphans and poor children were sheltered here and were growing up in a better environment. On the other hand, his children friend Akil Uddin was a senior officer in the office. He did not sign the file unless he got extra money in his pocket. The public were outraged by his actions but did not speak out of fear.
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is called Khayin?","marks":1,"answer":"The one who betrays the Amanat is called Khayin."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"“He who does not honour trust, does not have Imam.” — Explain.","marks":2,"answer":"In the Hadith, the Prophet (SAW) taught about the importance of safeguarding Amanat. Entrusting any money, wealth, words to someone is called Amanat. Protecting Amanat is one of the most important aspects of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah. Safeguarding Amanat is a must for the believer. A true believer never betrays Amanat. To teach importance of Protecting Amanat, the Prophet (peace be upon him) said, \"He who does not honour trust, does not have Iman\" (Musnad-i-Ahmad)"},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Evaluate the activity of the headmaster in the light of your textbook.","marks":3,"answer":"Service to humanity can be found in the action of the headmaster. Service to humanity refers to serving, caring, helping people etc. People can be served in many ways. Donating food to hungry people, providing shelter to the helpless, serving the sick, providing financial services to the poor etc. are included in the scope of Service to humanity. Which is seen in the work of the headmaster. According to the stem, the headmaster set up a child care center at his home. There, orphans, and poor children have been given the opportunity to grow in a better environment. His work is included in service to humanity. And this is a very commendable and exemplary work. Service to humanity is one of the qualities of a believer. Rewards for this are unlimited. The Prophet (SAW) said, \"You help those who are on earth. Then he who is in the heaven will help you\". (Tjirnizi). So the headmaster will make a way to get Allah's grace by doing service to humanity."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"“The activity of Akil Uddin is not relevant to Islam.” Analyze the rationality.","marks":4,"answer":"Mr. Akil Uddin's work revealed bribery, which is not permitted in Islam. Bribery means excessive gain. Acceptance of additional resources or privileges without due process is known as bribery. For example, accepting money in exchange for withholding someone's work is a form of bribery. Which is noticeable in the work of Mr. Akil Uddin. According to the stem, Mr. Akil Uddin does not sign the file unless he gets extra money in his pocket. His act carries the identity of bribery. And bribery is not supported at all in Islam. Money earned through bribery is totally Haram. Allah and Rasul (peace be upon him) do not like who takes bribe. Rasul (peace be upon him) said, \"Allah's curse is on both the offerer and the recipient of bribe.\" (Bukhari and Muslim) Elsewhere the Prophet (peace be upon him) said, \"Bribe-offerers and bribe-eaters, both of them are Jahamanis\" (Tabaram). So it can be said that the act of Mr. Akil Uddin is a part of bribery. And the ultimate consequence of bribery is the severe punishment of hell.\n---"}]

subject: Islamic And Moral Studies
question: Mr. Goni and Monir are two brothers. Goni is in a foreign country. Goni sends money to his younger brother Monir for supporting parents and family every month. Monir studies living with the elder’s brother Goni’s family. Recently, Monir completed his higher education. He spends his time sitting at home and chatting with his friends. Observing such condition of Monir, his uncle said, "Someday you will become a burden to the society."
parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is Zulfiqar?","marks":1,"answer":"Zulfiqar is a sword."},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Why is Hazrat Abu Bakr called the savior of Islam?","marks":2,"answer":"Hazrat Abu Bakr (Ra) is called the savior of Islam for his outstanding contribution to the service of Islam. After the death of the Prophet (PBUH), Hazrat Abu Bakr (Ra) very efficiently suppressed the apostates and Zakat deniers. Moreover, when there was a threat of the destruction of the Holy Quran because of martyrdom of many Haffiz of the Quran in the battle of Yamama, he arranged for the Holy Quran to be recorded in the book form. He is called the savior of Islam due to the implementation of these revolutionary measures."},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"What has been reflected in the activities of Mr. Goni?","marks":3,"answer":"In Mr. Goni's action, one of the virtues of Akhlaq-i-Hamidah, dutifulness is revealed. Dutifulness means doing one's duties properly, fulfilling one's responsibilities etc. As human beings we have many responsibilities and duties. Being aware of them, doing them properly and not neglecting these tasks is dutifulness. Mr. Goni's action indicates this quality. In the stem, the quality of dutifulness is revealed in Mr. Goni's work. Because, as a family member, it is our duty to fulfill the responsibility towards parents, siblings, relatives. Besides, we are entrusted with responsibility in various fields of society, nation and the world. Being aware of these and striving to perform them is called dutifulness. Dutifulness is one of the qualities of a believer. Allah Talaia describes His faithful servants as, \"They discharge their obligations and fear that Day on which the loss will be colossal\" (Surah Ad-Dahr, verse 7) If one neglect his/her duty, he/she will be held accountable for it in the Hereafter. In a Hadith the Holy Prophet (SAW) said, \"All of you (men) are trustees and you shall be questioned for your performance.\" (Bukhari) Therefore, it can be said that the quality of dutifulness is manifested in the work of Mr. Goni."},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Identify the condition of Monir and explain the statement made by the uncle.","marks":4,"answer":"Moni's behavior reveals quality of Akhlaq-i-Zamimah, indolence or aversion to work. His uncle's statement about this is correct. Indolence refers to the unwillingness to work. Being idle without doing any work despite having the ability to do is Indolence. Which is noticeable in Monir's behavior. In the stem, after completing his higher education, Monir sits at home and chats with his friends. He does not want to do any work which indicates aversion to work. Seeing his condition, his uncle said, \"One day you will become a burden to the society.\" His uncle's comment here is correct. Because indolence creates laziness in people. People become inactive. People's motivation and performance is reduced. Lazy people indulge in various dishonest and immoral thoughts and actions. As a result, people's talent, energy and time are wasted. No one likes an inactive unemployed person. Nobody wants to be friends with him. This results in a mindset of living on someone else's terms. And thus ultimately he became a burden to the family and society. Therefore, it can be said that Monir's uncle's comment about him is correct as his behavior shows indolence."}]
